data.name: Night Invasion
data.detailed_description:
About this product

Night Invasion is a top-down cooperative shooter where you form a four-member squad to resist increasingly aggressive waves of zombies. Each match is a tactical struggle where coordination, resource management, and quick reactions determine survival. The game delivers a dynamic, readable, and immediately accessible experience, whether played solo or online.

You can fight alongside AI teammates capable of following, covering, healing, or reviving allies, or join a server to cooperate with other players. The objective is simple: hold your ground, survive the waves, and defeat the final boss.

Key Features

Intense Cooperative Gameplay

  • Four-entity squad mixing human players and AI.

  • Teamwork is essential: support, covering fire, angles, and revives.

Dynamic Zombie Waves

  • Diverse enemies: fast runners, heavy units, explosive types, and specialized bosses.

  • Increasing pressure leading to a final assault.

Four Playable Classes

Each class has unique weapons, stats, and tactical roles:

  • Assault — M4, consistent damage, versatile frontline.

  • Sniper — Long-range elimination with high precision.

  • Medic — Healing, revives, critical support.

  • Engineer — Gadgets, MP5, technical assistance.

Weapons & Shooting Feel

  • Distinct weapons, visible projectiles, limited ammo with magazine management.

  • Grenades, rockets, explosions, and AI gunfire fully visible.

  • HUD alerts for ammo, reloads, and equipment tracking.

Large Urban Map

  • 4000×4000 city map with hospital, police station, houses, and open areas.

  • Items to collect: ammo, medkits, grenades.

  • Built-in minimap for constant orientation.

Advanced Allied AI

  • AI reposition to cover players, self-heal, or revive downed allies.

  • Each AI has a dedicated class to maintain a full squad.

  • Contextual messages from AI to enhance readability.

End-Game Results & Stats

  • Detailed scoreboard highlighting each player’s performance.

  • Collective validation to restart a game.

  • Full session reset in seconds.

Streamlined Multiplayer

  • Automatic listing of public servers.

  • Display of connected players and available slots.

  • Direct IP connection for private or self-hosted servers.

A Clear Vision

Night Invasion is designed to deliver fast-paced, demanding co-op gameplay without unnecessary complexity. Clear mechanics, well-defined classes, and a steady rise in intensity make every session unique. The combination of reliable AI, complementary classes, and terrain control offers an experience that’s both accessible and deep.
